Bridging Hearts Across Generations

Click above to navigate

Our Mission

We partner with senior centers to design programming that reduces isolation among older adults while giving young volunteers real, meaningful connection with their community's elders.

How We Started

HeartBridge began as a student-led effort to bring companionship and care to local senior centers, and has grown into an ongoing program of visits, activities, and donation drives.
